text: Ekadashi, the eleventh day, was set aside by our elders as a special time.
It was meant for turning our attention inward, away from the usual pull of appetite and towards quiet remembrance.
The true purpose was never about an empty stomach, but about the peaceful space it created within.
You might like to chant 'Om Namo Narayanaya' silently while you go about your daily tasks.
Or, perhaps read a few names from the Vishnu Sahasranamam.
In the evening, light a deepam and take a quiet minute to simply sit in its gentle glow.
